notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.03
notes.content:
[h1]Its time for the first round of major patches![/h1]

Version 1.03 brings the following changes to Boomerang Battles:

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

- Fixed a bug where spikes could damage you if even when down if you ran into them the moment the room started.
- Move difficulty text down slightly so it doesn't overlap with the timer.
- Health gain no longer random: 2 health for small chest, 2 + 6 health for golden chests
- You can no longer set difficulty settings while in a run.
- Boomerangs and items have a 50/50 odds of dropping instead of a 40/60
- Fixed a bug that caused chests to drop no items in higher level areas.
- Library styled rooms have had bookcases removed to make them easier.
- Pits have had their collision **completely overhauled** to be much more forgiving.

[h2]Additions[/h2]

- Changed main menu settings button text to "Settings & Difficulty" to make it more obvious that difficulty modes exist.
- Initial chest spawns 2 random different boomerangs after getting past level 30 instead of just 1 

Thank you to everyone that has played the game and given us feedback, we really apricate it!
Do send us screenshots of your runs and your best times, and also leave a steam review if you can, it'd really help us out.
Good luck in your next run!
